description: Register a skill (Anthropic Agent Skills format: a SKILL.md file with YAML front matter + markdown body) once, referenced by name (skill_keys) from the MCP-aware agent components instead of repeating the same source fields inline in every one of them.

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: Dagster resource key other components reference via skill_keys.

name.label: Name
name.description: Skill name override. If unset, read from the SKILL.md front matter at component load time.

description.label: Description
description.description: Skill description override. If unset, read from the SKILL.md front matter at component load time.

git_url.label: Git Url
git_url.description: Git remote URL to fetch the skill from (e.g. https://github.com/org/repo.git). Exactly one of git_url / local_path is required.

git_path.label: Git Path
git_path.description: Path within the git repo to the skill directory containing SKILL.md. Defaults to the repo root.

git_ref.label: Git Ref
git_ref.description: Git branch or tag to check out. An arbitrary commit SHA isn't guaranteed to work (depends on whether the remote allows fetching by SHA).

local_path.label: Local Path
local_path.description: Local filesystem directory containing SKILL.md. Exactly one of git_url / local_path is required.

git_token_env_var.label: Git Token Env Var
git_token_env_var.description: Env var holding a token for private-repo git auth (sent as an Authorization: Bearer header during clone).
